title: Nutty Crumbly Mediterranean Honey Cake Grill
description: A delicious, kid-friendly Mediterranean dessert featuring golden syrup and grilled to perfection. This diabetic-friendly recipe is perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium heat (around 375°F).
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, ground almonds, granulated sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the honey, golden syrup, egg, vanilla extract, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Grill the cakes for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown.
Transfer the cakes to a wire rack to cool.
Drizzle the cooled cakes with melted honey and sprinkle with chopped rosemary and thyme leaves.
